title: Scratch Decomposition, Loops, and Lists
prerequisites: Use basic Scratch events, sequence, conditions, and variables
Open and save a Scratch project
objectives: Break a Scratch program into a main program and named custom blocks.
Choose repeat, forever, or repeat until for a stated task.
Use a list to store and read related values.
Record a repeatable test and debug one likely cause at a time.
evidence: Saved Scratch filename or share link, code-structure explanation, and typed test record

requirements.software: Scratch online or Scratch desktop for the application task
requirements.account: No account required for module practice
requirements.storage: Progress remains in this browser and device

formalAssessment: Separate teacher directions and rubric are required.
